description:
This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class, which handles database operations related to employee work experience records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee work experience data, and adheres to a repository pattern.

The class extends a base DAO class and interacts with ORM entities and query builders, indicating it is part of the data access layer of the application.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for CRUD operations and searching employee work experience records in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Saves or updates an EmpWorkExperience entity; calculates the next sequence number if not explicitly set and performs validation before persisting.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's work experience record by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpWorkExperienceIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of sequence numbers for a given employee that match specified IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeWorkExperiences
methods.description: Deletes specified employee work experience records based on employee number and list of sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Performs a search for employee work experience records based on provided filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencePaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for paginated search results matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of employee work experience records matching the search filter criteria.
